testflight.whats_new:
New in this build:
- Improved: the progress card is tidier. Each part has its own section, the coach lists what to work on in one panel, and what you're strong at shows as green tags.
- Fixed: rank streaks you haven't tried looked locked. Every streak can be played at any rank, so try going back for an easier one.

Also recently:
- New: missed puzzles come back after 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30 days. Miss one or use a hint, and it returns tomorrow.
- New: Practise my weak spots on the coach card starts a mixed set of 10 that doesn't tell you which kind each puzzle is.
- New: your rating counts up or down after each puzzle.

Please try a practice set and a rank streak, and tell me anything that looks off.
